source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Αυγούστου — «Όσιος Χαιρήμων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The Russian row already keeps him on this menologion day and the Greek calendar keeps him on the revised-julian 16 August. The whole Greek notice is two sentences: «Ο Όσιος Χαιρήμων ήταν ασκητής της ερήμου. Απεβίωσε ειρηνικά την ώρα που εργαζόταν» — the venerable Chaeremon was an ascetic of the desert; he died in peace at the hour when he was working. The folder's «4th century», from days.pravoslavie.ru, stands: the Greek page gives no year and no century at all, and no country beyond the desert. The Greek line gives no epithet «of Egypt»; the folder's display name keeps the one the Russian source gave it. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no apolytikion and no kontakion, so no hymn is added.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs was read for the civil week 23–29 August 2026 (10–16 August ст. ст.), which names other saints; its page for this saint’s day was not read (2026-08-23).
